summary: An obligation can look completely different once you admit that the arrangement only works because you keep absorbing the part nobody else wants.
body: An obligation can look completely different once you admit that the arrangement only works because you keep absorbing the part nobody else wants. When Saturn conjuncts Lilith, duty meets the part of you that has stopped accepting the old terms, so a role, promise, contract, or responsibility may need to be renegotiated rather than silently carried. You may still care about the commitment. That does not mean every condition attached to it deserves to survive. Decide what you are still willing to do, what now belongs to someone else, and what happens if the arrangement cannot make that change workable.
